claims.claim_text: The system of claim 1 , wherein the membrane is configured to cover an opening of each drain pore of the secondary set of drain pores.
The system of claim 1 , wherein, during normal operation of the catheter, the secondary set of drain pores is closed.
The system of claim 1 , wherein the body includes a tubular body.
The system of claim 1 , wherein, upon rupturing of the membrane, fluid flows out of the catheter.
The system of claim 1 , wherein the membrane is configured to be ruptured at a pressure less than a pressure to unblock the primary set of drain pores.
The system of claim 1 , wherein each drain pore of the primary set of drain pores includes an opening in the body.
The system of claim 1 , wherein the pressure source includes a reservoir constructed and arranged to hold a volume of fluid, the reservoir configured to communicate with the catheter.
The combination of claim 8 , wherein the fluid in the reservoir is configured to apply the fluid pressure to rupture the membrane.
The system of claim 9 , wherein the reservoir comprises a pumping reservoir configured to pressurize the fluid to a first pressure to rupture the membrane.

The system of claim 1 , wherein the membrane is constructed and arranged to be ruptured upon application of the fluid pressure to open the secondary set of drain pores when the application of the fluid pressure fails to unblock the primary set of drain pores.
A ssytem for flushing a shunt catheter, the system comprising: a catheter, comprising: a body having a lumen therethrough;

The system of claim 12 , wherein the pumping reservoir is a first pumping reservoir configured to pressurize the fluid to a first pressure to rupture the membrane, and further comprising a second pumping reservoir configured to pressurize the fluid to a second pressure anticipated to be sufficient to unblock the primary set of drain pores, the second pressure lower than the first pressure.
The system of claim 13 , wherein the first pressure is selected to be about 10 torr greater than the second pressure.
